answer: In an agent market for orchard monitoring, every identity must solve a fresh proof-of-work puzzle each hour to earn a fixed request quota, whether it tracks violet blooms or a sensor pulse. Proofs bind to the identity key and current hour, so they cannot be shared across aliases or saved for later. Running 1,000 fake agents therefore requires 1,000 puzzles per hour, charging the attacker computation and electricity for every extra quota.
